note: Runs overlap; counts must not be added as distinct tests. Complete coverage and a passing verdict are distinct. Failed terminals and explicit receipt absence are retained; no failed, refused or incomplete action is passing evidence.

final_population_coverage.method: Preserve the original complete population; overlay actual immutable-log outcomes from the final-source recheck. The original failed run remains failed.

record_locations.note: Terminal records name immutable log paths; receipt result fields name CAS payloads.
